{{Quote|Authenticators identify the ships as CloakShapes and one Tempest-class gunship.|Sullustan communications technician|<ref name="CoD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Tempest''-class gunship''' was a type of small attack craft the size of a light [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]]. It was in use around the time of the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], and was used by criminal elements. [[Mercenary/Legends|Mercenary]] [[Arwen Cohl]]'s [[Hawk-Bat (gunship)|''Hawk-Bat'']] was perhaps the most famous ''Tempest''.<ref name="CoD" />
